The Horry County register of deeds records South Carolina deeds and mortgages.

Who records deeds in Horry County

  • Horry County Register of Deeds records deeds and mortgages.

What we confirmed on the official page

  • Fee schedule (price list updated 8/01/19, may be outdated): deed non-timeshare $15; mortgage $25; mortgage satisfaction $10; plat (legal size and under) $25; deed court order $15; doc stamps $2.60 state + $1.10 county per $1,000; certification $2; copies $0.50/page
  • eRecording offered for real estate professionals via county-approved vendors Simplifile, Corporation Service Company, eRecording Partners Network; must follow county pre-requisites and transmittal requirements

Horry County by the numbers

Horry County has about 368,937 residents and 211,686 housing units in the Census Bureau's 2019-2023 survey, number 4 by population among the 26 sc counties we cover. The median owner-occupied home is worth $260,500, 21% above the median of the sc counties covered. Median household income is $64,623, against $64,269 for the middle sc county. Owners live in 76% of occupied homes and renters in 24%. The median home was built in 1998, about 25 years ago.
